result.instructions: Tools for HappyFox, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes HappyFox data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run happyfox_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run happyfox_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run happyfox_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. happyfox_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: happyfox_list_tickets
tools.title: List or search tickets
tools.description: List tickets, newest activity first, with optional filters and HappyFox's search syntax. Paginated (page_info + data). Search `q` examples: `status:"New","In Progress"`, `priority:"High"`, `assignee:none`, `tag:"billing"`, `contact:"jane@example.com"`, `unresponded:true`, `breached:true`, `duedate:overdue`, `created-after:"2026/01/31"`, `last-modified-on-or-after:"2026/09/01"`, `"Custom Field":"value"`. Separate several filters with a space. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/tickets/.

status.description: `_all` (default), `_pending` (every pending-behaviour status), or a status id from happyfox_list_statuses.

category.description: Only tickets in this category id (happyfox_list_categories).

sort.description: Sort key, e.g. created (newest first), createa, updated, due, priorityd.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level fields to return, e.g. id,display_id,subject,status — keeps responses small.

minify_response.description: If true, return only ticket ids.

tools.name: happyfox_get_ticket
tools.title: Get one ticket
tools.description: Fetch a ticket with its full conversation: status, priority, category, contact, assignee, custom fields, SLA breaches and every update (messages, private notes, property changes, attachment links that expire in 5 minutes). HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/ticket/<ticket_number>/.

ticket_number.description: The ticket NUMBER (the `id` field, e.g. 3 for #DC00000003) — not the prefixed display id.

show_cf_changes.description: Include the history of custom-field changes in the updates.

tools.name: happyfox_list_contacts
tools.title: List or search contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers), paginated, or search them. Search `q` fields: name, email, phone (digits only, no +), updated_since, created_since — e.g. `name:adam email:adam@example.com` (space-separated, all must match). HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/users/.

q.description: Search string, `field:value` pairs separated by spaces.

tools.name: happyfox_get_contact
tools.title: Get one contact
tools.description: Fetch a contact by id or by email address — phones, contact groups, ticket counts and custom fields. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/user/<id or email>/.

contact.description: The contact's numeric id (e.g. "33") or email address.

tools.name: happyfox_list_contact_groups
tools.title: List contact groups
tools.description: List contact groups (typically customer companies) with their tagged email domains. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/contact_groups/.

tools.name: happyfox_get_contact_group
tools.title: Get one contact group
tools.description: Fetch a contact group and its member contacts. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/contact_group/<id>/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List ticket categories (queues) with their ids — needed to create a ticket or filter tickets. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/categories/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_staff
tools.title: List agents
tools.description: List agents (staff) with their ids, roles, categories and active flag — the `staff` id every reply/note needs, and assignee ids. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/staff/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_statuses
tools.title: List statuses
tools.description: List ticket statuses with ids and behaviour (pending / completed) — ids used to change a ticket's status. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/statuses/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_priorities
tools.title: List priorities
tools.description: List ticket priorities with ids — ids used to set a ticket's priority. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/priorities/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_ticket_custom_fields
tools.title: List ticket custom fields
tools.description: List ticket custom fields: id, type, choices (with choice ids), required flags and categories. Use the ids as t-cf-<id>. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/ticket_custom_fields/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_contact_custom_fields
tools.title: List contact custom fields
tools.description: List contact custom fields: id, type, choices and required flag. Use the ids as c-cf-<id>. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/user_custom_fields/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_reports
tools.title: List reports
tools.description: List the saved reports (id, name, description) from the Reports module. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/reports/.

tools.name: happyfox_get_report_summary
tools.title: Get a report summary
tools.description: Summary counts for a saved report: ticket, completed, assigned, pending and unassigned counts. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/report/<id>/.

tools.name: happyfox_get_report_tabular_data
tools.title: Get a report's ticket rows
tools.description: The tabular view of a saved report — one row per ticket (display_id, subject, status, assignee, due date), paginated. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/report/<id>/tabulardata/.

tools.name: happyfox_list_kb_articles
tools.title: Export knowledge-base articles
tools.description: Export the knowledge base: external (customer-facing) articles by default, or internal (agent-only) articles. HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/kb/articles/ or /kb/internal-articles/.

internal.description: true = internal articles; false/omitted = external articles.

tools.name: happyfox_create_ticket
tools.title: Create a ticket
tools.description: Open a new ticket on behalf of a contact (created if the email is new). Needs a category id (a public category), a subject and a message in `text` or `html`. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/tickets/.

text.description: Message in plain text (text or html is required).

html.description: Message in HTML (text or html is required).

category.description: The category (happyfox_list_categories; must be public) id.

priority.description: Priority id (happyfox_list_priorities); defaults to the default priority.

assignee.description: Agent id to assign the ticket to (from happyfox_list_staff); null to unassign.

cc.description: CC email addresses, as a comma-separated string.

bcc.description: BCC email addresses, as a comma-separated string.

visible_only_staff.description: true = private ticket, visible to staff only.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed "t-cf-<id>" / "c-cf-<id>". Ticket (t-cf-) and contact (c-cf-) fields; required ones must be present. Values: text = string, number = number, dropdown = choice id, multiple choice = array of choice ids, date = yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: happyfox_add_staff_reply
tools.title: Reply to a ticket as an agent
tools.description: Add an agent reply to a ticket and/or change its status, priority, assignee, due date or tags. The contact is emailed ONLY if update_customer is true (HappyFox default: false). With no message it just updates properties. Moving to a completed status may require the category's compulsory custom fields. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/ticket/<ticket_number>/staff_update/.

ticket_number.description: The ticket NUMBER (the `id` field, e.g. 3 for #DC00000003) — not the prefixed display id.

staff.description: The agent making the reply (happyfox_list_staff) id.

update_customer.description: true = send the reply to the contact by email. Default false.

subject.description: Override the subject of the email sent to the contact.

cc.description: CC email addresses, as a comma-separated string.

bcc.description: BCC email addresses, as a comma-separated string.

assignee.description: Agent id to assign the ticket to (from happyfox_list_staff); null to unassign.

time_spent.description: Minutes to add to the ticket's time spent (some categories require it).

tags.description: Tags to set, as a comma-separated string.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed "t-cf-<id>". Ticket fields (ids from happyfox_list_ticket_custom_fields); compulsory-on-completion fields are required when closing. Values: text = string, number = number, dropdown = choice id, multiple choice = array of choice ids, date = yyyy-mm-dd.

annotations.title: Reply to a ticket as an agent

tools.name: happyfox_add_private_note
tools.title: Add a private note to a ticket
tools.description: Add an internal note (never sent to the contact), optionally alerting agents and changing status, priority, assignee, due date or tags. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/ticket/<ticket_number>/staff_pvtnote/.

ticket_number.description: The ticket NUMBER (the `id` field, e.g. 3 for #DC00000003) — not the prefixed display id.

staff.description: The agent adding the note (happyfox_list_staff) id.

alert.description: Send a private alert: `s` = all subscribers, `c` = all agents in the ticket's category, or an agent id.

assignee.description: Agent id to assign the ticket to (from happyfox_list_staff); null to unassign.

time_spent.description: Minutes to add to the ticket's time spent (some categories require it).

tags.description: Tags to set, as a comma-separated string.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed "t-cf-<id>". Ticket fields (ids from happyfox_list_ticket_custom_fields); compulsory-on-completion fields are required when closing. Values: text = string, number = number, dropdown = choice id, multiple choice = array of choice ids, date = yyyy-mm-dd.

annotations.title: Add a private note to a ticket

tools.name: happyfox_update_ticket_tags
tools.title: Add or remove ticket tags
tools.description: Add and/or remove tags on a ticket without touching anything else. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/ticket/<ticket_number>/update_tags/.

ticket_number.description: The ticket NUMBER (the `id` field, e.g. 3 for #DC00000003) — not the prefixed display id.

staff_id.description: The agent making the change (shown in the ticket history) id.

add.description: Tags to add, as a comma-separated string.

remove.description: Tags to remove, as a comma-separated string.

tools.name: happyfox_update_ticket_custom_fields
tools.title: Edit a ticket's custom fields
tools.description: Set ticket custom-field values (t-cf-<id>, ids from happyfox_list_ticket_custom_fields). HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/ticket/<ticket_number>/update_custom_fields/.

ticket_number.description: The ticket NUMBER (the `id` field, e.g. 3 for #DC00000003) — not the prefixed display id.

staff.description: The agent making the change id.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed "t-cf-<id>". Ticket fields only. Values: text = string, number = number, dropdown = choice id, multiple choice = array of choice ids, date = yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: happyfox_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a contact. HappyFox treats this as create-or-edit keyed on email: if the email already exists that contact is updated, and any contact custom field NOT passed is reset — use happyfox_update_contact to edit an existing contact. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/users/.

type.description: mo = mobile, w = work, m = main, h = home, o = other (default).

id.description: Existing phone id, to edit that number instead of adding one.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed "c-cf-<id>". Contact fields (happyfox_list_contact_custom_fields); required ones must be present. Values: text = string, number = number, dropdown = choice id, multiple choice = array of choice ids, date = yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: happyfox_update_contact
tools.title: Edit a contact
tools.description: Edit an existing contact's name, email or contact custom fields (c-cf-<id>). Phone numbers are edited via happyfox_create_contact with the phone id. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/user/<id>/.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed "c-cf-<id>". Contact fields. Values: text = string, number = number, dropdown = choice id, multiple choice = array of choice ids, date = yyyy-mm-dd.
